title: Guard Core: Unvalidated X-Forwarded-For-derived string used as a Redis key component and interpolated into a KEYS glob…
description: Guard Core versions prior to 3.13.0 contain a vulnerability where the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header is extracted without IP address validation and used directly in Redis key names and KEYS glob patterns. This allows attacker-controlled strings to cause cross-client counter contamination, unbounded Redis key growth, blocking Redis scans, and potential server errors due to unhandled exceptions. The issue affects deployments where the extracted XFF entry is attacker-controllable and trusted proxies are configured. No data exposure is reported. A fix is available in version 3.13.0 that validates the IP and escapes glob metacharacters or replaces the KEYS command usage.
